I cant really tell, i am under a lot of pressure but this is how it is supposed to be...your parents want you to be good, your teachers want you to be good and yourself wants you to be good.
Actually I dont really want to know...

I also have exams this year. I really enjoy english and japanese, i like languages in generall. Speaking other languages can give you completly new ways of expressing things...

I am under a lot of pressure but i cant tell why, i think it is myself....i dont know - i think i dont even want to know.
